news.text: Our PhysLadder technical report on GPT-6 Astra's contact-rich manipulation capabilities is available on arXiv.
We release GaussianDream++, with paper available.
We release GaussianWAM, with paper available.
Jingdiao Cup Graduation Design Competition, First Prize.
Fuse and Refine is submitted to IROS.
Software-Defined Parallel LiDARs for Active 3D Perception is completed as a first-author work.
Champion, ROBOCON Programming Challenge; Third Place, ROBOCON Granary Challenge.
